image_description: A side-profile view of a vintage-style electric smoothing iron against a white background. The iron features a dark, textured body (possibly Bakelite or hard plastic) with a metallic gold/brass trim along the edge. A black power cord with a two-prong plug is visible in the lower left foreground. The soleplate is partially visible but mostly obscured by the angle.

The prongs of the plug appear slightly fused or ill-defined at the tips, and the connection point to the wire lacks clear mechanical definition, appearing somewhat 'melted' into the insulation.
